text: 21.com launched in June 2026 as an online casino and sportsbook led by founder and chief executive Michael Carlton, who previously ran BetVictor for 17 years; the site operates under a gaming licence issued by the Autonomous Island of Anjouan (Union of the Comoros).
short: 21.com launched June 2026 under founder-CEO Michael Carlton

source.name: iGaming Republic: Ex-BetVictor boss launches crypto casino 21.com
source.quote: 21.com has launched as an online casino and sportsbook, the company confirmed on 16 June 2026. The brand is led by founder and chief executive Michael Carlton
